configurePresets.name: _base
configurePresets.description: Common SPPARKS options: Release, MPI, HighFive/HDF5, image output.

configurePresets.name: _kokkos-hip
configurePresets.description: Kokkos HIP backend. Concrete presets must set SPPARKS_KOKKOS_ARCH.

configurePresets.name: mi300a
configurePresets.description: MI300A APU nodes behind a Cray programming environment (El Capitan, Tuolumne, El Dorado, RZAdams, ...). Load rocmcc/<ver>-magic + cray-mpich + cray-hdf5-parallel first. AMD_GFX942_APU (not AMD_GFX942) is required: it is what defines KOKKOS_IMPL_HIP_UNIFIED_MEMORY, so HIPSpace uses the APU's unified HBM. Needs HSA_XNACK=1 at RUNTIME. -march=native assumes you configure on a node matching the run node, which is the intended workflow; set SPPARKS_NATIVE_OPTIMIZATION=OFF if you ever configure on a login node instead.

configurePresets.name: mi300a-discrete
configurePresets.displayName: AMD MI300A APU, unified memory DISABLED (A/B control)
configurePresets.description: Same hardware and same --offload-arch=gfx942 as the mi300a preset, but the non-APU arch token leaves KOKKOS_IMPL_HIP_UNIFIED_MEMORY undefined. HIPSpace then reports accessible=false to HostSpace and uses a host-inaccessible SharedAllocationRecord, so DualView keeps a distinct host mirror and deep_copy does real work -- the same code path strix-halo takes. The allocator is hipMalloc either way, so this isolates the cost of the explicit copy machinery with hardware held constant. Run WITHOUT HSA_XNACK=1 to match. Keep this in its own build dir: Kokkos_ARCH_* is cached with FORCE, so two arch tokens in one directory both stay ON and Kokkos errors out.

configurePresets.name: strix-halo
configurePresets.description: Local development APU (Radeon 8050S/8060S). Physically an APU, but Kokkos classifies gfx1151 as UNABLE to access system allocations (Kokkos_HIP_IsXnack.hpp) and gives it ordinary discrete HIPSpace -- so this preset does NOT exercise the unified-memory path the mi300a preset takes. Kokkos < 5.x needs patches/kokkos-gfx1151.patch, applied automatically at configure time.

configurePresets.name: openmp
configurePresets.description: CPU reference/validation build. Safe to interrupt, unlike a HIP job. Note that OpenMP's static scheduling structurally hides GPU races -- a green result here does not clear the device path.
